title: kith-tslocal: Argument<Value> footgun documented but not prevented
description: resultref.rs has a detailed warning: 'Do not parameterize this type with serde_json::Value for deserialization. Value accepts any JSON, so the Ref variant can never be reached via serde when T = Value.' This is a real footgun — a handler author who writes Argument<serde_json::Value> for a field that might be a ResultReference will silently get the wrong behavior. The documentation is good but cannot prevent misuse. Consider: (a) adding a compile-time sealed-trait bound that prevents Argument<Value> from being instantiated, or (b) renaming the type to make the constraint obvious in the name (e.g. TypedArgument<T> with a note that T must be a non-Value type). Filed as P1 because the footgun is invisible until runtime and produces silent wrong behavior, not a compile error.
